en.headline: Education Bureau urges school to strengthen values education after vaping video
en.dek: The bureau contacted Po Leung Kuk Yao Ling Sun College in Tsuen Wan after a video of students in uniform appeared to show vaping inside a toilet cubicle.
body: The Education Bureau said it reached out to a Tsuen Wan secondary school after a video purporting to show female students vaping in a school toilet circulated online.

The footage showed several students in school uniform taking a selfie inside a cubicle, with one holding what appeared to be an electronic cigarette. Po Leung Kuk Yao Ling Sun College confirmed the students belonged to the school and said it was very concerned about the case.

The school stated it had already arranged meetings with the students' parents. "We are committed to nurturing students’ good character, and there are disciplinary and counselling mechanisms to provide students with appropriate support and guidance," the school said.
The Education Bureau said it was aware the school had activated its crisis management mechanism and reminded the school to strengthen efforts to cultivate correct values and behaviour among students.

zh.headline: 教育局促荃灣中學加強價值教育 因應學生疑在校內吸電子煙影片
zh.dek: 教育局聯絡保良局耀靈中學，因一段顯示身穿校服學生在廁格內疑吸食電子煙的影片在網上流傳。
body: 教育局表示，在一段聲稱顯示女生在校內廁所吸食電子煙的影片在網上流傳後，已聯絡荃灣一所中學跟進。
片段顯示數名身穿校服的學生在廁格內自拍，其中一人手持疑似電子煙。保良局耀靈中學確認學生為該校學生，並表示對事件高度關注。
校方表示已與相關家長會面。校方聲明指：「我們致力培養學生的良好品格，並設有紀律及輔導機制，為學生提供適當支援及指引。」
教育局表示知悉校方已啟動危機管理機制，並提醒校方加強培養學生正確的價值觀及行為。
